no_assets_reason: Source evidence acquisition from craigslist.org is unavailable in the configured environment: the live site returns HTTP 403 to non-browser and datacenter-origin requests, and no authenticated session or cloud browser channel is configured. The clone therefore uses no third-party runtime assets; all images, fonts, stylesheets, and scripts are authored locally and served same-origin. Any future source capture round may add assets without altering this contract.
